messages:
Rae (docs): Heads-up — my docs PR #4599 is blocked by the preview. Linkcheck flags a broken anchor and one JS example still uses `timeout_ms`. Can runtime confirm the canonical server timeout and the recommended client pattern?

ci-bot: Deploy preview 4599 — build failed. Linkcheck: /api/streaming#stream-timeout (404). Example test failed: streaming-usage.test.js. Logs: https://deploy.example/4599/logs

Kofi (runtime): Short answer: hosted control plane enforces 120s for stream activity. We deprecated client-side `timeout_ms` in SDK v1.3. Clients should use AbortController or SDK helpers (e.g., withTimeout). Dedicated: new pools default to 120s; some legacy Dedicated pools may still be at 60s.

Rae (docs): Thanks. The PR currently has:
```js
await client.stream({ model: 'rwd-large', prompt, timeout_ms: 30000 })
```
so definitely from older docs.

Leah (sdk): Correct — SDK accepted `timeout_ms` up to v1.2.x. In v1.4 we shipped `client.withTimeout(ms, fn)` and the recommended pattern is AbortController. Please pin examples to @redwood/sdk@1.5.3 in the docs to avoid confusion.

Marco (platform): Tiny add: some enterprise Dedicated customers keep legacy profiles intentionally. Recommend adding a one-sentence backcompat note telling readers to check their deployment profile or contact SE.

Rae (docs): Plan: 1) replace the `timeout_ms` snippet with an AbortController example plus an optional `withTimeout` helper example (JS + short Python cancellation example), 2) pin the codeblock to v1.5.3, 3) add a short callout: "Hosted default 120s; legacy Dedicated pools may be 60s — contact support." 4) fix the anchor to the current heading id. I'll push changes in ~30m.

ci-bot: Build queued for deploy-preview 4600.

Leah (sdk): Ping me after you push and I'll sanity-check the snippet. Also suggest showing how to log the final routingDecision metadata so readers can debug why a stream closed.

Kofi (runtime): Good idea — a one-line example of `res.routingDecision` is useful. I'll provide the exact wording for the callout: "Hosted: 120s. Dedicated pools: 120s for new pools; legacy Dedicated pools may be 60s. If unsure, check your deployment profile or contact support."

ci-bot: Deploy preview 4600 — success. Linkcheck fixed, example test passed.

Leah (sdk): Snippet looks good and uses v1.5.3 helpers.

Marco (platform): LGTM on the wording and backcompat note.

Rae (docs): Merged. Thanks y'all — leaving a follow-up issue to sweep legacy examples across docs. :sparkles:
